items.title: Neural Text Style Transfer with Adversarial Learning
items.description: I built a semi-automated pipeline to rewrite Bengali sentences in five author styles without parallel corpora using BiGRU encoder with Gradient Reversal Layer (GRL) and style-conditioned GRU decoder.

items.title: AcademicLens — Citation Graph Mining at Scale
items.description: I built a large-scale academic intelligence system over 10M+ OpenAlex research papers using PySpark & Neo4j with distributed Author–Paper–Citation–Topic graph and PageRank influence ranking.

items.title: Stellar Object Classification (SDSS DR18)
items.description: I engineered a multi-class classification system classifying galaxies, quasars, and stars using CatBoost & XGBoost with Optuna Bayesian hyperparameter tuning, achieving >99% test accuracy.

items.title: Traffic-Aware Single-Drone Delivery Route Optimisation
items.description: I evaluated deterministic and stochastic hill climbing algorithms for drone delivery route optimization across 120 delivery locations with node-level congestion modeling.
